description: TY2025: the OBBBA deduction stack, small business. Gross 1,000,000; ordinary 200,000; equipment 300,000 fully expensed (SS 168(k) 100%, permanent); domestic R&E 100,000 expensed (SS 174A) + foreign R&E 30,000 at the 15-year midpoint first year (1/30 = 1,000) -> research 101,000; interest 50,000 fully allowed (avg gross receipts 5M under the $31M SS 448(c) test). TI = 349,000 -> 21% = $73,290.00.
